analogy: An atom appears to pulse through a radial crest.
established_kernel: Prepared coherent Rydberg superpositions can have time-dependent radial probability; a stationary eigenstate does not.
standard_equation: Psi(r,t)=sum_n c_n R_nl(r)Y_lm exp(-i E_n t/hbar); omega_nm=(E_n-E_m)/hbar
proposed_component: Translate crest language into a disclosed wave-packet state and test for any residual beyond the declared Hamiltonian.
domain_units: Hydrogenic atomic units; time and frequency in SI
observable: Radial density/current, revival time, and pump-probe ionization proxy.
null_model: Single eigenstate with stationary |psi|^2 and no extra interaction.
falsifier: Failure to reproduce revival structure, or a proposed residual that does not survive basis/dephasing controls, stops the bridge.

analogy: Bonding and magnet forces feel like pressure or cancellation.
established_kernel: Maxwell stress and Born-Oppenheimer energy gradients already predict forces in their domains.
proposed_component: Use a stress-flux ledger while retaining domain-specific constitutive laws; do not posit a scalar ether pressure.
domain_units: Force, torque, energy, and stress in SI
observable: Force/torque maps, bond curve, dissociation energy, and vibrational spectrum.
null_model: Maxwell/Born-Oppenheimer baseline with measured geometry and nuisance controls.
falsifier: No unit-consistent cross-domain map or no held-out residual prediction; retain as notation only.

analogy: BEC, compact stars, and feedback systems seem to store support then release it.
established_kernel: Each domain has its own stability, binding, and relaxation equations.
proposed_component: Test a preregistered dimensionless phase comparison without treating C or Pi as universal physical quantities.
observable: Instability boundary, release fraction, and relaxation scaling on a held-out domain.
null_model: Independent domain models fitted without a shared cross-domain exponent.
falsifier: Post-hoc plot collapse, non-identifiability, or held-out failure rejects the claimed transfer.

analogy: Planck-scale bubbles might leave a tiny propagation or decoherence signature.
established_kernel: Precision Lorentz and propagation tests constrain simple linear dispersion and preferred-frame models.
standard_equation: E^2=p^2 c^2+m^2 c^4+eta_n p^2 c^2(E/(M_star c^2))^n
proposed_component: Parameterize one covariant correction and fit its first observable coefficient; a no-residual model is operationally standard physics.
domain_units: Energy, momentum, time, and dimensionless coupling in SI/conventional units
observable: Arrival-time difference, birefringence, interferometer noise, atomic shift, or GW propagation residual.
null_model: Lorentz-invariant QFT/GR propagation plus calibrated instrument/systematic model.
falsifier: Coefficient violates existing bounds, fails QED/GR recovery, or is absorbed by nuisance terms; stop the branch.

analogy: A non-expanding universe could explain redshift by energy loss alone.
established_kernel: Supernova light curves exhibit approximately (1+z) time dilation; CMB/BAO/lensing form additional constraints.
proposed_component: Build a joint discriminator over clock stretch, spectral/brightness effects, CMB temperature, BAO, and lensing instead of fitting distance-redshift alone.
domain_units: Cosmological redshift, time, brightness, angular scale, and temperature
observable: Joint likelihood with an explicit nuisance model and held-out redshift range.
null_model: Expanding metric plus source evolution and calibration nuisance model.
falsifier: A static model that requires hidden time dilation, misses the joint likelihood, or cannot preserve blackbody/BAO/lensing relations is rejected.
